commands.summary: Plan and execute the create page reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda create page apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new page in the configured doc; requires Doc Maker access in the workspace, queued for async processing (202)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete page reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda delete page apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a page (and its subpages/content) from the doc; irreversible, queued for async processing (202)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete row reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda delete row apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a row from a Coda table; irreversible, queued for async processing (202)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete rows reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda delete rows apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes multiple rows from a Coda table in one request; irreversible, queued for async processing (202)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update page reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda update page apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames, hides, or restyles an existing page; renaming/re-iconing requires Doc Maker access in the workspace, queued for async processing (202)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update row reverse-ETL action
examples: pm coda update row apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: overwrites cell values on an existing row; queued for async processing (202) and generally applied within seconds
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
